---
name: Reproducible bug
about: Report a geometry, runtime, provider or installation problem
---

Describe the expected result and the observed result.

Include a minimal input/project, exact command, source/build identifier, platform,
dependency versions, requested quality and resource limits. For solver issues,
include units, material/marker mapping and solver configuration. State whether
the result is invalid geometry, unmet quality, a budget stop or a backend error.

Remove credentials, OAuth callback values, private provider logs and sensitive
survey data before sharing. A small synthetic reproducer is welcome.
